method: Read each canonical exact-v1 Source Review and the accepted Books writeback item.
Read the complete semantic-body binding in the current owner chapter, its preceding and following prose, and the named adjacent chapters.
Check source-specific mechanism, changed constraint, state/data/control ownership, gain/cost, failure, fallback/coexistence, exact-v1 non-proof boundary, chapter flow, and owner uniqueness.
Count the semantic-body binding markers across all Books and confirm the mechanism body precedes chapter Review notes; Review notes alone were not accepted as integration evidence.
